 ><header class="entry-header"><div class="entry-info"><h1 class="entry-title">Kiteweek 2027 Feb.13-20</h1></div></header><div class="background-video-buttons-wrapper"> <a class="wpzoom-button-video-background-play display-none">Play</a> <a class="wpzoom-button-video-background-pause display-none">Pause</a> <a class="wpzoom-button-sound-background-unmute display-none">Unmute</a> <a class="wpzoom-button-sound-background-mute display-none">Mute</a></div></div><div class="entry-content"><div class="fl-builder-content fl-builder-content-6157 fl-builder-content-primary" data-post-id="6157"><div class="fl-row fl-row-full-width fl-row-bg-photo fl-node-5d5d1dc682c87 fl-row-default-height fl-row-align-center fl-row-bg-overlay" data-node="5d5d1dc682c87"><div class="fl-row-content-wrap"><div class="fl-row-content fl-row-fixed-width fl-node-content"><div class="fl-col-group fl-node-5d5d1dc6b830e" data-node="5d5d1dc6b830e"><div class="fl-col fl-node-5d5d1dc6bc017 fl-col-bg-color" data-node="5d5d1dc6bc017"><div class="fl-col-content fl-node-content"><div class="fl-module fl-module-wpzabb-heading fl-node-5d5d1dc641ee4" data-node="5d5d1dc641ee4"><div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content"><div class="wpzabb-module-content wpzabb-heading-wrap wpzabb-heading-align-center "><h2 class="wpzabb-heading"> <span class="wpzabb-heading-text">The original kiteweek</span></h2><div class="wpzabb-module-content wpzabb-separator-parent"></div></div></div></div><div class="fl-module fl-module-rich-text fl-node-5d62e2159f825" data-node="5d62e2159f825"><div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content"><div class="fl-rich-text"><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>At week 7 the hotel in Pallas opens their door for us. The week is special in so many ways. No matter who you meet in the hotel or what table you sit down during breakfast or dinner you can just start to chat about the wind and share your stoke. Days we spend outside kiting, hiking, chilling, laughing and playing. In the evenings we gather up in the hotel to share the experiences of the day. Most evenings we have special things planned out from mountains safety to kite pub quiz to the legendary Pallas Gnar photo contest!</strong></p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="fl-col-group fl-node-5d5d1dc6920ae" data-node="5d5d1dc6920ae"><div class="fl-col fl-node-5d5d1dc686991 fl-col-bg-color fl-col-small" data-node="5d5d1dc686991"><div class="fl-col-content fl-node-content"><div class="fl-module fl-module-wpzabb-image-icon fl-node-5d5d1dc695db7" data-node="5d5d1dc695db7"><div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content"><div class="wpzabb-module-content wpzabb-imgicon-wrap"> <span class="wpzabb-icon-wrap"> <span class="wpzabb-icon"> <i class="fas fa-bed"></i> </span> </span></div></div></div><div class="fl-module fl-module-wpzabb-heading fl-node-5d5d1dc6acbf1" data-node="5d5d1dc6acbf1"><div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content"><div class="wpzabb-module-content wpzabb-heading-wrap wpzabb-heading-align-center "><h3 class="wpzabb-heading"> <span class="wpzabb-heading-text">Travelling alone or with friends?</span></h3><div class="wpzabb-module-content wpzabb-separator-parent"></div></div></div></div><div class="fl-module fl-module-rich-text fl-node-5d5d1dc699ac1" data-node="5d5d1dc699ac1"><div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content"><div class="fl-rich-text"><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>For the kiteweek we offer accommodations from single room to shared 3 person accommodation so you can come alone or with your mates</strong></p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="fl-col fl-node-5d5d1dc68a69a fl-col-bg-color fl-col-small" data-node="5d5d1dc68a69a"><div class="fl-col-content fl-node-content"><div class="fl-module fl-module-wpzabb-image-icon fl-node-5d5d1dc69d7ca" data-node="5d5d1dc69d7ca"><div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content"><div class="wpzabb-module-content wpzabb-imgicon-wrap"> <span class="wpzabb-icon-wrap"> <span class="wpzabb-icon"> <i class="fas fa-mortar-pestle"></i> </span> </span></div></div></div><div class="fl-module fl-module-wpzabb-heading fl-node-5d5d1dc6b4604" data-node="5d5d1dc6b4604"><div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content"><div class="wpzabb-module-content wpzabb-heading-wrap wpzabb-heading-align-center "><h3 class="wpzabb-heading"> <span class="wpzabb-heading-text">What is included</span></h3><div class="wpzabb-module-content wpzabb-separator-parent"></div></div></div></div><div class="fl-module fl-module-rich-text fl-node-5d5d1dc6a14d4" data-node="5d5d1dc6a14d4"><div class="fl-module-content fl-node-content"><div class="fl-rich-text"><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>The original kiteweek includes accommodation with breakfast and dinner. On top of this you have the hotel facilities at your disposal (sauna, gear service rooms, storage etc.)</strong></p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="fl-col fl-node-5d5d1dc68e3a4
